channel.title: PlanWellHome
channel.description: Practical templates, planners and printables for everyday jobs at home and at the office: budgets and bills, schedules and checklists, trackers and pages you can print. Each one comes with an illustrated step-by-step guide.

item.title: Christmas Budget & Gift Planner: Christmas without the January bill shock
item.description: Plan every gift and every holiday expense in one simple spreadsheet, and know exactly how much you have left to spend.

item.title: Debt Snowball & Avalanche Tracker: See your exact debt-free date
item.description: Enter your debts once and see your debt-free date, the order to pay them off, and how much interest you'll save.

item.title: Sinking Funds Tracker: Know exactly what to save each month
item.description: Stop being surprised by 'irregular' expenses. Plan for them monthly and pay cash when they arrive.

item.title: Home Maintenance Checklist & Tracker: Never miss a filter, flush or gutter again
item.description: A simple system for everything your house needs, built by someone who estimates construction costs for a living.

item.title: Debt Payoff App: A real debt payoff app. No spreadsheet, no subscription.
item.description: One file you open in your browser. No account, no app store, no monthly fee, and your numbers never leave your device.

item.title: Debt & Sinking Funds Printable Pack: Color your way out of debt
item.description: Simple, calm printables for your budget binder. Print as many as you need.

item.title: Renovation Budget & Bid Planner: Budget your renovation like a pro estimator
item.description: Built from real construction cost-estimating practice, for homeowners planning a remodel.

item.title: Contractor Bid Comparison Sheet: Compare contractor bids line by line
item.description: The cheapest bid is often the most expensive one. Built by a construction cost estimator to show you why, line by line.

item.title: Net Worth & Savings Goals Tracker: Watch your net worth grow, month by month
item.description: Own minus owe, tracked monthly. The single most motivating number in personal finance.

item.title: Money Reset 2027 Bundle: Your complete 2027 money reset
item.description: Everything you need to start 2027 with a plan: budget, debt payoff, sinking funds and net worth, in one download.

item.title: 2027 Printable Calendar: Your whole year, ready to print
item.description: A calm, clean 2027 calendar for the fridge, the binder or the office wall. Print it at home in minutes, as many times as you like.

item.title: Habit Tracker 2027: Watch your year fill with color
item.description: A colorful habit tracker that does the counting for you: tick a box, and your scores, streaks and charts update by themselves.

item.title: Habit Tracker Printables: Plan it, track it, color it in
item.description: Seven calm, undated habit pages to print at home: plan your habits, tick them off, color in your streaks and look back each month.

item.title: Meal Planner & Grocery List: Your grocery list writes itself
item.description: Pick your meals for the week and get a ready-to-shop grocery list, sorted by aisle, with what it will cost.

item.title: Meal Planner Printables: No more 5 pm dinner panic
item.description: Eight calm kitchen pages to print at home: plan the week, shop by aisle, keep your recipes and track your food budget.

item.title: Cleaning Schedule: Chores shared, scheduled, done
item.description: Every chore in one place, shared out fairly, with a printable plan for the week that updates itself.

item.title: Cleaning Checklist & Chore Chart: Know what to clean, and when
item.description: Eight calm cleaning pages, already filled with what to do, so you just print and tick. Add your own tasks on the blank lines.

item.title: To-Do List & Weekly Planner: Get it out of your head and onto paper
item.description: Eight clean, undated planner pages for home and the office: plan the day, the week and the month, sort your priorities and track projects.

item.title: Password Log: Every login, in one private place
item.description: A calm, private paper home for your logins: A-Z cards, Wi-Fi and devices, subscriptions and the accounts your family may need in an emergency.

item.title: Home Reset 2027 Bundle: Your whole home, planned for 2027
item.description: Everything to run a calmer home in 2027, in one download: habits, meals and groceries, cleaning, your calendar, to-dos and passwords.

item.title: Wedding Planner & Budget: Every dollar, guest and to-do in one place
item.description: Plan the whole wedding in one calm spreadsheet: the budget, every vendor payment, the guest list and a dated 12-month checklist.

item.title: Wedding Checklist & Planner: Twelve months of planning, ready to print
item.description: Eleven calm, pretty pages to plan the whole wedding on paper: the checklist, the budget, vendors, guests, seating and the day itself.

item.title: Small Business Bookkeeping: Tax-time ready, all year long
item.description: Simple bookkeeping for freelancers, makers and small shops: log income, expenses and miles, and get a monthly P&L and a tax summary for your accountant.

item.title: Workout & Fitness Planner: Plan it, log it, watch the progress
item.description: Plan your training week, log every workout in seconds and see your streak, best lifts and body changes on one dashboard.

item.title: Content Calendar & Social Media Planner: Plan the posts. See what works.
item.description: Plan every post in one place, see the month at a glance, and find out which content actually works for your brand.

item.title: Invoice & Estimate Workbook: Look professional. Get paid on time.
item.description: Make clean, professional invoices and estimates in minutes, and always know who has paid, who's late and how your quotes are doing.

item.title: Gantt Chart Project Planner: Your whole project on one timeline
item.description: Plan any project on a clean Gantt chart that draws itself: tasks, owners, dependencies, milestones and progress, with a dashboard on top.

item.title: Moving Planner & Checklist: Every box, bill and to-do, on time
item.description: Plan the whole move in one place: a dated week-by-week checklist, a moving budget, every box by room and who needs your new address.

item.title: Garden Planner: Know exactly when to sow, plant and pick
item.description: Type your last frost date and get every date your garden needs: when to start seeds, plant out and harvest, plus bed plans, seeds and harvest.

item.title: Small Business Starter Bundle: Run the business side, all in one place
item.description: Four tools for the business side of a small business or side hustle: keep the books, send invoices, plan your content and run projects.

item.title: Wedding Guest List & RSVP Tracker: Every guest, every reply, every seat
item.description: The whole guest side of the wedding in one calm spreadsheet: invitations, RSVPs, meals, tables, addresses and thank-you notes.

item.title: Bridal Shower Games: Eight games, ready to print tonight
item.description: A full afternoon of bridal shower fun in one download: eight classic games, advice cards, a scoreboard and the answer keys.

item.title: Wedding Planning Bundle: Plan the whole wedding, all in one place
item.description: Four tools for the whole wedding: the budget and vendors, the guest list and RSVPs, a printable planning checklist, and the bridal shower games.

item.title: Bill Tracker & Calendar: Never miss a due date again
item.description: Every bill in one calm spreadsheet: what's due this month, what's paid, what's late, and where the money goes.

item.title: Budget Binder: Your whole money plan, in one binder
item.description: Sixteen calm, undated pages to plan your money by hand: budget, bills, savings, sinking funds and debt, all in one binder.

item.title: Savings Challenges: Ten ways to save, one color at a time
item.description: Ten printable savings challenges to color in as you save: from a penny a day to $10,000, plus your own goal and a log.

item.title: Reading Tracker: Your year in books, beautifully tracked
item.description: Track every book you read this year: your goal and pace, your streak, your favorite genres, and a bookshelf that fills up month by month.

item.title: 2027 Digital Planner: Tap a tab, land on the day
item.description: A calm, dated 2027 planner for your tablet: 73 linked pages that take you from the year to the month to the week in one tap.

item.title: Student Planner & Assignment Tracker: Every class, every due date, every grade
item.description: Stay on top of the semester in one spreadsheet: what's due this week, what's late, your grade in every class and your GPA.

item.title: Study Planner: Your whole semester, planned on paper
item.description: Ten calm, undated pages to plan a semester by hand: classes, homework, exams, notes and your GPA.

item.title: Book Journal: Every book you read, beautifully kept
item.description: Ten calm, undated pages for your reading life: a bookshelf to color in, a log, reviews, your to-read pile and a reading challenge.

item.title: Weight Loss Tracker: See every pound, and when you'll reach your goal
item.description: Track your weight loss calmly: every weigh-in, your real pace, your milestones and the date you'll reach your goal.

item.title: Kids Routine & Reward Charts: Calmer mornings, easier bedtimes
item.description: Ten bright, undated pages that turn the morning rush and bedtime into steps your child can follow on their own, with rewards that make it fun.

item.title: Family Emergency Binder: Everything your family needs, in one place
item.description: Sixteen calm, undated pages that put every number, plan and document your family needs in an emergency into one binder you can grab.

item.title: Job Application Tracker: Every application, every interview, what to do next
item.description: Keep your job search calm and moving: every application, its next step and follow-up, your interviews and your network in one place.

item.title: Bills & Budget Binder Bundle: Bills, budget and savings, sorted
item.description: Three tools that work together: a bill tracker that warns you before anything is late, a printable budget binder, and savings challenges to color in.

item.title: Student Success Bundle: Classes, grades and reading, all sorted
item.description: Four tools for a calmer semester: track every assignment and grade, plan your study weeks on paper, and keep a log of everything you read.

item.title: Baby Shower Games: Eight games for a happy baby shower
item.description: Eight easy, gender-neutral baby shower games in calm sage, with answer keys, keepsake cards and a scoreboard: just print and play.

item.title: Travel Planner: Plan the trip, pack the bag, keep the memories
item.description: Thirteen calm, undated pages for any trip: plan every day, keep bookings and budget in one place, pack without forgetting a thing.

item.title: Recipe Book: Keep the family recipes, beautifully
item.description: Eleven warm, undated pages to collect the recipes your family loves, with the stories behind them, and plan the meals around them.
